hardware_observation.first_manual_presmoke_step: failed before a banner or usable REPL
hardware_observation.first_red_rule: stopped; no downstream hardware case was claimed

breakpoint_diagnosis.observed_loop: c2_dma_copy repeatedly operated with its descriptor state at the fixed Bank-0 C2 domain near $c0b2 before that domain was CPU-visible
breakpoint_diagnosis.ordering_at_failure: boot/C2 fixed-domain consumers ran before c2_kernal_take_ownership

root_cause.mechanism: The product entered C2 code that depends on fixed Bank-0 state and the $e000 resident window before the ownership handoff had copied, verified and mapped those domains.
root_cause.why_the_screen_was_black: The failure occurred before screen initialization and before a usable product error path existed.

required_fix_and_gate.product_fix: Move c2_kernal_take_ownership before every staged-overlay and C2 boot consumer.
required_fix_and_gate.permanent_gate: Bind the source order and the complete pre-handoff direct closure; no fixed C2 domain may be reached before successful ownership.
required_fix_and_gate.hardware_recheck: A fresh candidate must restart the receipt-less pre-smoke at manual step 1; no Link-21 green is inherited.

claim_limit: Receipt-less hardware diagnosis of Link 21 only. It proves a first-red at the ownership-order boundary and no hardware acceptance, product promotion or release claim.
